entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It's true that even if we erase the[n]Metaverse, there's no assurance that[n]the world will get better.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: And if we lose our powers, we won't be[n]able to stand up against criminals like[n]Shido ever again...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Then, would it be more definite if we[n]changed criminals' hearts as they come[n]up, just as we've done?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I honestly can't tell which is the best[n]method to go about this.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: However, Shido has had a change of[n]heart. I doubt he'll make trouble should[n]he become prime minister.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It won't sit well with us though...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...So we should be targeting criminals[n]and not the general public, huh?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: This is where I belong... I wanna continue[n]bein' part of the Phantom Thieves!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I will... defer to our leader's decision.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Then, we'll continue on as phantom[n]thieves together?
